name: Mono- and diacetyltartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
what_it_is: An emulsifier made by joining fats to tartaric and acetic acids. Bakers call it DATEM.
why_its_added: Strengthens bread dough so loaves rise higher and hold their shape.

india.note: Maximum level depends on the food. Examples below.

vegetarian_status.means: Can be made from either plant or animal sources. The label is not required to say which one was used.

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.

india_limits.food_category: Dairy-based drinks - flavoured milk and/or fermented
Fermented milks (plain) heat treated after fermentation
Sterilized and UHT creams, whipping and whipped creams, and reduced fat creams (plain)
Plain processed cheese/ processed cheese, processed cheese spreads
Flavoured processed cheese, including containing fruit, vegetables, meat etc.
